title: TcArchiveOverview
description: tc/archive/<YYYY>/overview.json (docs/tc.md section 8.3): each storm's track at its synoptic times, small enough for a picture of the season.

archiveSchemaVersion.description: A reader rejects a version above the one it implements.

track.description: The US best track, else the first with points.

OverviewPoint.description: [lon x 10, lat x 10, class]: tenths of a degree, and the Saffir-Simpson class of the wind from 0 (TD) through 1 (TS) to 2-6 (H1-H5), -1 where there is none.
